class.name: FlowGraphState
class.brief_description: Saved state of a [FlowGraphPlayback], for savegames.
class.description: [method FlowGraphPlayback.get_state] fills a [FlowGraphState]; [method FlowGraphPlayback.set_state] restores it. Save it like any resource, or store it inside your own savegame resource. The state names the node on every graph level; the graphs of inner levels follow from the [FlowSubgraphNode]s of the outer levels, so only the main graph is stored ([member graph_path]). If the graph changed since the state was saved (nodes removed), [method FlowGraphPlayback.set_state] fails with [constant ERR_INVALID_DATA]. [codeblocks] [gdscript] ResourceSaver.save(player.get_playback().get_state(), "user://quest_state.tres") # Later: var state := load("user://quest_state.tres") as FlowGraphState player.get_playback().set_state(state) [/gdscript] [csharp] ResourceSaver.Save(player.GetPlayback().GetState(), "user://quest_state.tres"); // Later: var state = GD.Load<FlowGraphState>("user://quest_state.tres"); player.GetPlayback().SetState(state); [/csharp] [/codeblocks]

members.member: The main graph, as [code]uid://[/code] text when the graph has a UID, else as path. Empty for a graph built in code.
The version of this layout, [constant STATE_LAYOUT_VERSION] when saved. A newer version is refused by [method FlowGraphPlayback.set_state].
One [Dictionary] per graph level: node id to the value stored with [method FlowGraphPlayback.set_node_memory]. Only nodes that stored a value are listed.
The current node id on every graph level, main graph first. Empty when the playback did not play.
A copy of the variables of the blackboard.
If [code]true[/code], the current node was waiting.

constants.constant: The layout version this engine writes.
